## 席位核对 — REWORK (L1-b)

Head-sha: 56c5e5182f673302e3ca01d0be4d05f8f06c7d6d · read 2026-11-21T11:01Z · 7 files +833/−66 · checks at this head: 53 success · 12 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending · l1-face CLEAN (13 items)

**维护者速读：** 这一刀把表单里明细表格的下拉格、日期格改成"在格子下面弹面板"，长文本格输入时向右浮出，Esc 撤回本格这次的修改且不再关掉外层对话框——方向和 Sales 09:40Z 的裁决一致（Esc 一律撤回，明细表 Enter 仍是下移/新增行）。但有一处会丢数据：Esc 撤回时按"第几行"记住旧行，删掉或拖动行之后再回到同一位置的格子按 Esc，会把已删掉的那行写回来、顶掉现在那一行。用户看到的是：本想"取消"，结果一行明细被另一行（甚至已删除的行）覆盖。需要修一下再合并，改动很小（行结构变化时丢掉记住的快照，加一个测试）。

### Must-fix

**M1 — Esc restores a stale line after a line is removed, moved or duplicated above it.** `GridField.tsx:1187-1227`: the visit snapshot is `{ key: "rowIdx:col", rowIdx, row }`, taken on the first focus of that key; `onGridBlur` keeps it while focus moves to anything inside the table (the row's own Duplicate / Delete buttons included) and `onGridFocus` keeps it when focus returns to the same key. Rows are keyed by index (`<tr key={rowIdx}>`, line 1717), and `removeRow` / `moveRow` / `duplicateRow` (lines 1229-1265) never touch `cellVisit`. Read from the code (not run here), lines A, B, C:

1. Focus B's last cell (`1:amount`), visit = {1:amount, B}.
2. Tab to B's Delete button (inside the table → visit kept), Enter → rows [A, C]. The row-1 `<tr>` and its button are reused, so focus stays on it.
3. Shift-Tab back to `1:amount`, which now draws C: same key → visit kept, still holding B.
4. Esc: `current[1]` (C) !== B → `emit([A, B])`. **C is gone and the deleted B is back**, written as a normal change.

The mouse path is the same in Chrome (a clicked button takes focus): edit `1:x`, click A's Delete, click `1:x` again (now the old C… or B shifted up), Esc → the line at index 1 is overwritten by the snapshot of a different line. Drag-reorder (`moveRow`) and Duplicate on an earlier line shift indices the same way. Esc is the key a user presses to *not* change anything, so this is silent data loss.

Fix, either is enough: drop the visit in every structure change (`cellVisit.current = null` in `removeRow`, `moveRow`, `duplicateRow`, `addRow`), and/or guard the restore on the snapshot still being where it was (store `rows.length` with the visit and refuse when it differs). Please add a test: two or three lines, focus line 1's cell, remove line 0 (or line 1 by its button), return to the same key, Esc → no `onChange` carrying the stale line.

### Should-fix

**S1 — the user-facing sentence says "that cell"; the code puts the whole line back.** The changeset title says "Esc in a cell takes back only that cell" and `plugin-form.mdx` says "Esc in a cell takes back what you changed in that cell". The code (and `README.md`, and the code comment) restores the whole line as it was on entry, other cells included (a lookup pick's autofill). Align the changeset title and the mdx sentence with the README ("puts the line back as it was when the cell was entered"); the changeset's own bullet already says it right.

### Nits

- N1 — a date / date-time cell opens its calendar on every arrival, so Esc there always takes two presses (first closes the calendar, second takes back). That follows from "a cell whose panel is open hands Esc to the panel", but no test pins the second press in a date cell; one line in the `Esc in a cell` block would.

### Checked

- Esc listener: window capture, skips `defaultPrevented` and IME keys, hands Esc to an open panel by `[aria-expanded="true"]` inside the cell (the date input is itself the PopoverTrigger, so it matches); the select list's search box is portaled, so `cellKeyOf` is null there and Radix closes the list. Only mounted when `editable` (not readonly / list). Matches ruling 7060745834 (Esc always discards; line grid keeps Enter).
- `GridSelectCell`: the child `onClick` `preventDefault` stops the trigger's own toggle (Slot runs the child handler first, the trigger's composed handler checks `defaultPrevented`); typed character opens with `initialQuery`, `InCellOptionList` starts `active` at 0 when a query is present; Tab in the panel moves to `neighbourTabbable`; pick / Esc return focus to the trigger. `focus:ring-1 focus:ring-ring/60` matches the `SelectTrigger` it replaces.
- `GridDateCell`: open on focus, `onOpenAutoFocus` prevented so the caret stays in the native input, `onCloseAutoFocus` refocuses only after a pick (`refocus`) with `quietFocus` so it does not reopen; blur into the panel keeps it open (Radix content is a `tabIndex=-1` box, so a click on a day lands focus inside the panel); datetime keeps `HH:mm` (`00:00` when none). Impossible-day text moves to the panel, the `title` and an sr-only `aria-describedby` span; the stored value is still not written until a pick.
- `GrowingCellInput`: measures only while focused, at zero width, bounded by `[data-line-items-scroll]`'s right edge; one top-up pass, `scrollLeft = 0` once nothing overflows; spacer holds the row height; width cleared on blur.
- Inlined `toLocalDay` / `fromLocalDay` keep `./date-picker/` out of the eager closure (comment says why).
- Shape: draft, `Part of #36023` (S4/S5 last carries `Fixes`), one changeset `@object-ui/fields` patch, `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`; no files outside the slice.

### Owed

- Rework for M1 + S1, then a delta read here on the new head. The seat's declaration L2 decision is unchanged by this record. `pm:dispatched` stays on #36023 (Part of).

## 席位核对 — delta ACCEPT (L1-b)

Head-sha: fbbaaa99 (one commit on 56c5e518, 5 files +87/−6) · read 2026-11-21T11:13Z · prior record REWORK 7061619015 · CI at this head still running when read; this ACCEPT holds on green

**维护者速读：** 上次指出的丢数据问题已修好：现在只要增加、删除、复制或拖动明细行，Esc 记住的旧行就作废，回到格子再按 Esc 不会把删掉的行写回来；另外还核对行数作为第二道保险。文档措辞也改成了"整行回到进格子时的样子"，和实际行为一致。无新问题，CI 绿后本审读即为终审。

### M1 — resolved
- `cellVisit` is set to `null` in `addRow`, `removeRow`, `duplicateRow` and `moveRow` (declared above `addRow` so the callback can reach it); the snapshot now carries `count`, and the restore refuses when `visit.count !== current.length`, which covers a host that replaces the lines itself.
- Walked the reported path again: B's last cell, Tab to Delete, Enter (visit cleared), Shift-Tab back (`onGridFocus` sees no visit and takes a fresh snapshot of C), Esc does nothing. Clicking the drag handle moves focus out of the input with no related target, so the visit was already cleared on that path.
- Tests: `it.each` over removing the visited line by its own button, removing the line above, and duplicating the line above. Each returns to the same key, presses Esc, and expects no new `onChange` and the same lines. A further test shows a new visit after the change still takes back its own edit. The thread reports these four fail with the fix removed (its reading, not repeated here).

### S1 — resolved
The changeset title and `plugin-form.mdx` now say the line goes back to how it was when the cell was entered, lookup fill-ins included. The mdx and the README add that a line change ends the visit.

### N1 — resolved
A date cell test now shows that the first Esc closes the calendar and keeps the typed day, and the second Esc takes the day back to the stored `2026-06-17`.

### Checked
- The delta touches only the five files above. No change to the panels, the Esc listener's routing, the changeset frontmatter or the declarations (`Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`). The relation is still `Part of #36023`.

### Owed
- CI green at fbbaaa99. The L1 is final then. The seat's declaration L2 decision is unchanged. `pm:dispatched` stays on #36023 (Part of).

L1-b REWORK 7061619015 (Esc wrote back a stale line after a line was removed, moved or copied), fixed on `fbbaaa99`, delta ACCEPT 7061752192, final on this green head. `check-governed-merges --pr 36039` reads NOT governed (+914/−66). `landing-k` was not needed: the seat read K by hand, 9 since the merge base, under 15, and main since then touches neither `translations/` nor `skills/`. ### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [44899740254](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/44899740254) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Build & E2E UI](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/44899740254/job/136833344523)** — 失败步骤: check:eager-closure — weigh the Console's eager closure against its budget（日志不可读，点进 job 看）

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- ⚠️ **本次没有可用的聚合签名**（日志里没有能解析出测试文件名的 FAIL 行）—— 这不是「没有同签名的其他 PR」，是**这一轮没测到**。跨 PR 聚合本次不可用，请手工比对其他 PR 的同类评论。
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 2 个失败构建（不含本次）。

**分诊清单：**
1. 失败测试在本 PR 改动的包里 → 真回归，修 PR。
2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。
3. 两者都不是 → 可能与同组 PR 语义冲突；等前面的 PR 落地或失败出队后再重排一次即可，不要连续重排。
